steps.what_is_done: identify the forcing time convention, units, completeness and spatial alignment with the setup data
steps.must_establish: a file timestamp alone does not establish its represented interval

steps.what_is_done: record the adopted physics options and parameter files
steps.must_establish: the checkout's own parser is inspected before applying a namelist key learned from another version

steps.what_is_done: state whether the run starts from prescribed fields, repeated forcing spin-up, or a compatible restart
steps.must_establish: an equilibration diagnostic and tolerance for the relevant stores is chosen; a prescribed number of loops is not proof of equilibrium

steps.what_is_done: run a short authorized interval into a separate directory
steps.must_establish: timestamps, missing values and the requested state/flux diagnostics are inspected
steps.check: accumulation-and-fill (on the short interval's output, for missing/large-negative values)

steps.what_is_done: before continuation, check restart time and configuration, forcing continuity, existing live jobs, and whether the executable would append to or replace outputs
steps.must_establish: an existing restart filename alone is not proof of a successful restart (see pitfalls)
